events.subtitle: be:coming USA Tour
events.factual_description: Union Stage Presents lists Raaginder's be:coming USA Tour at Pearl Street Warehouse in Washington, DC on Saturday, October 3, 2026, with doors at 6:00 PM and the show at 7:00 PM. The presenter and Raaginder's official site identify him as a San Francisco Bay Area violinist, composer, and songwriter rooted in Indian classical raga whose current music moves through R&B, pop, hip-hop, and global electronic production. Raaginder's official tour calendar independently confirms the October 3 Washington date and additional headline dates including National Sawdust in Brooklyn on October 9, 2026. Apple Music lists the four-track be:coming EP, released May 29, 2026. No additional live personnel or official face-value ticket price was announced in the primary sources checked for this record.

enrichment.note: The exact presenter event page, event-specific authorized Opendate purchase destination, and exact Apple Music be:coming EP page are verified. Door/show times, venue, artist identity, tour context, and current musical framing are source-backed. The primary ticket sources checked do not expose a stable official numeric face-value price, so price remains null rather than inferred from third-party listings. No unannounced live personnel were inferred.

Repository-wide search returned no Raaginder RADAR record before publication. Stage 1 admission rests on the specific violin-led Indian-classical/contemporary synthesis and local live context. Priority was assigned only after admission; A+ was retained after challenging whether A would adequately express the local recommendation, while the documented multi-city tour rules out scarcity-tier treatment.

en.why_it_matters: Raaginder makes the violin carry two histories at once: the phrasing and modal pull of Indian classical raga, and the pulse and production logic of contemporary R&B, hip-hop, and electronic music. The be:coming material makes that synthesis the center of the project rather than a decorative crossover move. In a compact Washington room, the appeal is hearing how much of that architecture can stay inside the bow, phrasing, and live rhythmic feel.
en.trip_verdict: If the October 3 night is open in the DMV, actively make room for Pearl Street Warehouse. It is a local discovery date with enough instrumental identity to build the evening around, while the wider tour means there is no reason to chase another city if Washington works.

es.why_it_matters: Raaginder hace que el violín cargue dos historias al mismo tiempo: el fraseo y la gravedad modal del raga clásico de India, y el pulso y la lógica de producción del R&B, el hip-hop y la electrónica contemporánea. El material de be:coming pone esa síntesis en el centro del proyecto, no como un simple adorno de crossover. En una sala compacta de Washington, el atractivo está en escuchar cuánto de esa arquitectura puede quedarse dentro del arco, el fraseo y la sensación rítmica en vivo.
es.trip_verdict: Si la noche del 3 de octubre está libre en el DMV, sí le haría espacio a Pearl Street Warehouse. Tiene suficiente identidad instrumental para construir la noche alrededor de esta fecha local, y la gira amplia significa que no hace falta perseguir otra ciudad si Washington funciona.
